title: Find the Sequence of Strings Appeared on the Screen
summary: Given a string target, return a list of all strings displayed on the screen as Alice types it using a special keyboard with two keys: one appends 'a' and the other changes the last character to its next in the alphabet.
statement: Given a string target, return a list of all strings displayed on the screen as Alice types it using a special keyboard with two keys: one appends 'a' and the other changes the last character to its next in the alphabet. The list should include every string shown in the order they appear, using the least number of key presses.
constraints: Key one appends a; key two increments only the last character cyclically.
Return every nonempty screen state on a minimum-keypress route to target.
hints: Each target position must first be created with append-a, then incremented until it reaches the desired letter.
Finish characters left to right because only the final character can change.
Record immediately after the append and after every required increment.
Every recorded press is forced: one append per character and exactly its alphabet distance from a, proving minimality and unique states.
editorial: Every recorded press is forced: one append per character and exactly its alphabet distance from a, proving minimality and unique states.

tests.explanation: The states are a, aa, ab, aba, abb, abc.
Increment the first a through h, append a, then increment it through e.
